title: 참고로 포르투칼 전 SoccerAge 평점입니다.
bodyHtml:
06/14/2002. Lee Woon-Jae: 6.5
Choi Jin-Cheul: 8
Kim Nam-Il: 7.5
Yoo Sang-Chul: 7.5
Kim Tae-Young: 7
Seol Ki-Hyeon: 7
Lee Young-Pyo 7.5
Ahn Jung-Hwan: 7
Hong Myung-Bo: 7.5
Park Ji-Sung: 8
Song Chong-Gug: 8.5

Subs: Lee Chun-Soo (On for Ahn Jung-Hwan 90) No Rating.

Best: Where do I start? Every South Korean player worked their shocks off and fully deserve their achievement and the overwhelming praise they will receive from their adoring fans. Song Chong-Gug was the pick of the players i n my opinion, he man-marked Luis Figo superbly. Choi Jin-Cheul was another
player that stood out after a faultless display.

Worst: How can any player be criticised after Korea's achievement? Lee Woon-Jae had the quietest match in goal for Korea, but that isn't a criticism.

06/14/2002. Vitor Baia: 7.5
Nuno Frechaut: 6
Rui Jorge: 6
Jorge Costa: 6
Fernando Couto: 6.5
Armando Petit: 5
Paulo Bento: 5.5
Luis Figo: 6.5
Joao Pinto: 4
Pedro Pauleta: 6
Sergio Conceicao: 5

Subs:

Jorge Andreda (On for Pauleta 68) 5
Abel Xavier (On for Jorge 74) 5
Nuno Gomes (On for Frechaut 80) 4

Best: Only one Portuguese player can walk away from this match with any credit and that is Vitor Baia. The goalkeeper kept his team-mates in with a chance with four great saves in the closing minutes.
Worst: Joao Pinto left his team with so much to do after his disgraceful tackle that left the referee with no option but to send him off. Armando Petit was possibly unlucky to be sent off, but his second booking came from a naive foul. Segio Conceicao's defending for the crucial Korean goal was woeful, although he came mightily close to redeeming himself in the dying stage
s. Substitute Nuno Gomes wasted a guilt-edged chance to equalise soon after coming on and the miss will haunt him for many years.

워스트 줄 사람이 없어서 이운재를 뽑았을 정도이니...오늘 경기가 어떠했는지 잘 말해주고 있네요.(못해서 워스트가 아닙니다.)
